close_reason: anchorNotFound was already implemented in all query handlers; added mailbox_query_anchor_not_found_returns_error test
description: RFC 8620 §5.5: when anchor is specified in a query but the anchor ID is not in the result set, the server MUST return an error response with type='anchorNotFound'. jmap-test-suite paging-anchor-not-found test validates this. Check our Email/query and Mailbox/query handlers — verify they return this error type when anchor is provided but not found in results.
title: jmap-mail-server: anchorNotFound error in query handlers
